race.comment: Very weak Maiden. FABULOUS FIANO (1) jumps in trip fourth-up and can find form over the 1700m. Dropped in trip and found the 1300m too sharp when fifth at Casino a week-and-a-half ago. Gets map favours and can shed his Maiden tag. BILLS ANGEL (6) has struggled in three career starts and expected to aim up here. Since fitted with a comfortable trial win over 1400m. No surprise to see her turn things around. TURPIN'S TORMENT (5) closed strongly for a tough second over this track and trip two back, then back in trip and offered little when sixth over 1450m at Quirindi. Genuine top three contender. JUNOSTAR (8) fourth up for this and can race closer today from the rails draw. Kept finding with a plugging third over 1900m at Casino. Stays in the calculations.
